data.body: Implementation evidence: consumer inventory is recorded in the plan description. RED test was tests/unit/test_plan_relation_snapshot.py::test_retained_snapshot_states_do_not_scale_with_unrelated_store; it failed before the production change because unrelated store rows remained in ticket_states_by_id, and passes after retaining only subject/direct child/prerequisite rows. Real-store measurement on this checkout (9,081 tickets) with comparable tracemalloc/deep-size probes: legacy retained all-state map 256,646,460 bytes with 257,578,139-byte peak; new collect peak 259,876,851 bytes (transient compile unchanged) and retained snapshot 37,046 bytes across 1 retained row for this ticket. Focused consumer tests passed: 58 passed across plan relation snapshot, production batch runner, sidecar, generation scope, and sign transaction. make verify reached the known Copilot GIT_CONFIG repo-isolation artifact only; rerun solo with injected GIT_CONFIG_* unset passed.
